issue.title: sase/memory/sase_beads.md Statuses list is missing the snoozed task-bead status
issue.description:
Proposed by sase-gn.1 and sase-gn.9 (epic sase-gn) as PROPOSED FOLLOW-UPs. The epic deliberately did not fix this itself: its D7 decision forbade memory edits, and the repo rule is that sase/memory/*.md and the generated AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md/GEMINI.md/OPENCODE.md/QWEN.md shims may only be edited with explicit owner permission granted in the conversation doing the edit. This task exists to put that request in front of the owner.

Confirmed stale as of epic sase-gn landing. sase/memory/sase_beads.md 'Statuses' reads:

  open (draft) . claimed (runtime reserved) . ready (task bead awaiting triage) . in_progress . closed

It has no 'snoozed', even though snoozed is now a real task-bead status in the Rust core, the SQLite mirror (see the CHECK constraints in src/sase/bead/_db_schema.py), the Python model, every detail surface, and docs/beads.md's Status Lifecycle, which sase-gn.9 already updated.

Proposed edit, for the owner to approve: add snoozed between ready and in_progress in the Statuses list, with a one-line gloss along the lines of 'snoozed (task bead deferred to a wake time or +1 target; set only by sase bead snooze, never by update --status)'. sase-gn.1 separately suggested the Snoozed notification tab may deserve a mention; that is a judgment call for the owner, since sase_beads.md covers beads and docs/notifications.md already documents the tab.

Whoever does this must, after editing the canonical note, run 'sase memory init' to regenerate AGENTS.md, the provider instruction shims, and the memory README.

payload.entry: Added snoozed between ready and in_progress in sase/memory/sase_beads.md's Statuses list, with the gloss (task bead deferred to a wake time or +1 target; set only by sase bead snooze, never by update --status). Edited the canonical source (src/sase/main/init_memory/templates/memory-sase-beads.template.md), then ran sase memory init to regenerate sase/memory/sase_beads.md and sase/memory/README.md. Left the Snoozed notification-tab cross-reference out per the owner's judgment-call note (docs/notifications.md already documents that tab). Verified just check's lint gates pass and confirmed the only 2 SASE-validation failures (init memory --check wanting to refresh chezmoi home shims, init skills --check wanting to overwrite sase_gate skill files) are pre-existing on a clean master, unrelated to this change. Left the 3 changed files staged, uncommitted, per instructions.
